model: Hybrid 2 - pooled ConvNeXt-Tiny+CBAM image features + MLP over tabular (age, BMI) -> CORAL head
selection_reason: Better of two seed runs (42: val QWK 0.8260, 7: 0.8080); seed 42 used.
tabular_features_requested_but_unavailab: sex - no sex/gender column exists anywhere in unified_oai_dataset.csv (1193 columns checked exhaustively)
jsw_exclusion_reason: Phase 2: JSW not validated (medial_min_jsw vs medial JSN rho=-0.179, threshold was rho<=-0.3)
bmi_imputation: training-set median (28.20), applied to 6 missing train values and unchanged to val/test
tabular_standardization: training-set mean/std only, applied unchanged to val/test

vs_kl_final.selection_outcome: did NOT beat kl_final on val (0.8170 < 0.8416)

notes: Both seeds hit their best val QWK within the first 2 epochs and degraded afterward - the same instability pattern seen in Hybrid 1, consistent with a randomly-initialized new head destabilizing an already-converged fine-tuned backbone. Test-set numbers are numerically higher than kl_final but not statistically significant, and val selection favored kl_final. Not adopted as the project's best model.
